IED.Settings.AltRules.Name: Alternate energy drain rules
IED.Settings.AltRules.Hint: Off (default, rules-as-written): 24 hours after each bestowal, one Fortitude save per level — failures become permanent. On: bestowed levels never become permanent and there is no 24-hour timer; instead, each full rest (once per day) allows one Fortitude save against the lowest save DC among the creature's negative levels to shed a single level.
